zh-CN.title: 《道德经》
zh-CN.subtitle: 道家思想的核心文本之一
zh-CN.shortSummary: 《道德经》的成书、编纂和作者归属具有复杂层次，后世道教与哲学传统不断重新解释它。
curatorialDescription: 本馆把文本形成、传统归属、章句版本和后世解释分开呈现，不把‘老子说’直接等同于单一历史时刻。
zh-CN.researchNote: 文本成书区间、出土材料和传世本差异需要在完整文本版本模型中继续展开。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 成书与编纂：战国至汉代区间

en.title: Daodejing
en.subtitle: One of the key texts of Daoist thought
en.shortSummary: The formation, compilation and attribution of the Daodejing have several historical layers, and later Daoist and philosophical traditions repeatedly reinterpreted it.
curatorialDescription: The museum separates textual formation, traditional attribution, chapter versions and later interpretation instead of treating ‘Laozi said’ as a single historical moment.
en.researchNote: Composition ranges, excavated materials and differences among received editions will be expanded through the full text-version model.
en.timeLabel: Composition and compilation: Warring States to Han ranges
